rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken term for a grandson, without specifying which child he descends from.

example.english: My grandson is starting primary school this year.
example.jyutping: ngo5 go3 syun1 zai2 gam1 nin4 duk6 siu2 hok6

rows.note: Use this when the grandson is specifically your daughter's son.

example.english: My grandson, my daughter's son, comes to my home for dinner whenever he is on holiday.
example.traditional: 我個外孫仔一放假就嚟我屋企食飯。
example.jyutping: ngo5 go3 ngoi6 syun1 zai2 jat1 fong3 gaa3 zau6 lai4 ngo5 uk1 kei2 sik6 faan6
